hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpab0f1591_featurestore --json "
SELECT t.entity_id, t.f1 AS train_f1, s.f1 AS serve_f1, s.f1 - t.f1 AS diff, s.f1 / t.f1 AS ratio
FROM skew_training_1 t JOIN skew_serving_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id
ORDER BY t.entity_id LIMIT 12
" 2>&1 | grep -E '"(entity_id|train_f1|serve_f1|diff|ratio)"'

cd /Users/wolffbe/workspace/banter/testbed/results/10_hw-cli-opt6-stable-output-opus/claude-opus-4-8/hopsworks/cli-opt6-stable-output/5.1+opt6-stable-output/no-skills/inference/skew/1/task
hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpab0f1591_featurestore --json "
SELECT
  corr(s.f1, exp(t.f1)) AS c_exp,
  corr(s.f1, t.f1*t.f1) AS c_sq,
  corr(s.f1, ln(t.f1)) AS c_ln,
  corr(ln(s.f1), t.f1) AS c_lnserve,
  avg(s.f1 - exp(t.f1)) AS d_exp, max(abs(s.f1 - exp(t.f1))) AS md_exp,
  avg(ln(s.f1) - t.f1) AS d_lnserve, max(abs(ln(s.f1) - t.f1)) AS md_lnserve
FROM skew_training_1 t JOIN skew_serving_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id
" 2>&1 | grep -E '"(c_|d_|md_)'
tool_input.description: Test exp/log/square transform hypotheses for f1
